# Cedric Stanhope & Nell Harcourt

- [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) — Comrade of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — employed alongside Cedric Stanhope · since v2  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)</sub>
- [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — mutual understanding and affection between teacher and pupil · since v2  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.
>
> — v2 · VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)_

> Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to the cemetery with her young pupil [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), who talks about his late mother, his father, and his life with his grandmother. At the graveyard, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) places flowers on the graves of [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md), then walks home with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), discussing her teaching, ideals, friendship, and future prospects.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P24](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) discuss Nell's education, future prospects, and gratitude for her life and friends. They talk about the true nature of friendship, contrasting deep loyalty with shallow connections like that of [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) and Julia.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) at his house, where they discuss his thoughts, his late mother, and his worries about his maid's comments before sharing tea together. Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to comfort a jealous [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) and listen to his evening prayers.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_

> After recounting a story about losing and finding streetcar fare, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) for a day outing. They open the house, reminisce about [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), test the echoes with an old horn, and head home after sunset.
>
